name: shinchantw_cbt_d0_single_first_charge_d1_path_20260730_164132_586559
sql:
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
D0NewUsers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e."#account_id" AS account_id
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'new_role'
      AND e."#account_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
PayOrders AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        e."$part_date" AS pay_date,
        e."#event_time" AS pay_time,
        e.product_id,
        dp."product_id@product_type" AS product_category,
        dp."product_id@product_name_tc" AS product_name,
        CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(x.exchange, 1) AS pay_amount_usd,
        ARRAY_JOIN(TRANSFORM(e.a_rst, z -> CAST(z.name AS VARCHAR)), '+') AS gift_content
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date" = x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency = x.currency
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 dp ON CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER) = CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist b ON e."#user_id" = b.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-30'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
),
D0Pay AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS d0_pay_orders, MIN(pay_time) AS d0_first_pay_time
    FROM PayOrders
    WHERE pay_date = '2026-07-29'
    GROUP BY 1
),
D1Pay AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY pay_time) AS d1_pay_order
    FROM PayOrders p
    WHERE pay_date = '2026-07-30'
),
TargetUsers AS (
    SELECT n.account_id, d.d0_first_pay_time
    FROM D0NewUsers n
    INNER JOIN D0Pay d ON n.account_id = d.account_id AND d.d0_pay_orders = 1
    INNER JOIN D1Pay r ON n.account_id = r.account_id
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
D0FirstOrder AS (
    SELECT p.*
    FROM PayOrders p
    INNER JOIN TargetUsers t ON p.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE p.pay_date = '2026-07-29'
),
D0Stage AS (
    SELECT
        e."#account_id" AS account_id,
        MAX(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS BIGINT), TRY_CAST(e.stage_id AS BIGINT))) AS d0_max_stage_id,
        COUNT(*) AS d0_stage_attempts
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    INNER JOIN TargetUsers t ON e."#account_id" = t.account_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" = '2026-07-29'
      AND e."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND CAST(e.a_rst[1].key AS INTEGER) = 1001
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    r.account_id AS "账户ID",
    d0.product_category AS "D0首充商品类型",
    d0.product_id AS "D0首充商品ID",
    d0.product_name AS "D0首充商品",
    ROUND(d0.pay_amount_usd, 2) AS "D0首充金额USD",
    d0.gift_content AS "D0首充礼包内容",
    st.d0_max_stage_id AS "D0最高主线关卡ID",
    st.d0_stage_attempts AS "D0主线挑战次数",
    r.d1_pay_order AS "D1第几笔充值",
    r.pay_time AS "D1充值时间",
    ROUND(DATE_DIFF('minute', CAST(t.d0_first_pay_time AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(r.pay_time AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60.0, 1) AS "距D0首充小时数",
    r.product_category AS "D1商品类型",
    r.product_id AS "D1商品ID",
    r.product_name AS "D1商品",
    ROUND(r.pay_amount_usd, 2) AS "D1金额USD",
    r.gift_content AS "D1礼包内容"
FROM TargetUsers t
INNER JOIN D0FirstOrder d0 ON t.account_id = d0.account_id
INNER JOIN D1Pay r ON t.account_id = r.account_id
LEFT JOIN D0Stage st ON t.account_id = st.account_id
ORDER BY "账户ID", "D1第几笔充值"
